_comment: Every string at the day boundary. One file rather than three: a writer tuning the tone of this moment should not have to keep two files in sync. Predicate ids in remarks[].requires must exist in REMARK_PREDICATES in src/ui/daySummaryView.ts — a dev-only assertion checks this at boot.

lines: You did not leave the floor today. This has been noted, though not by anyone.
Eight hours, one room. Efficient, in a sense.
One period of {stationary} without recorded movement. Equipment fault has been ruled out.
Distance covered: {feet} feet. The mail cart covered more, and it is not paid.
You entered every room in the building. There are {total}. One of them is the corridor.
Friday. Your week is now historical data.
The week is complete. Complete and good are recorded in the same field.
This summary is generated automatically. No one reads it.
Distance covered is recorded for insurance purposes and is not a performance metric.
Figures are provisional until reconciled. Reconciliation is not scheduled.
Your activity was within normal parameters. Normal parameters are not published.
A copy of this summary has been placed in a folder.
Thank you for your continued presence.

weekend: Saturday. You did four loads of laundry and thought about the fax machine twice.
You went to a hardware store for one item and left with that item.
Someone from work waved at you in a supermarket. Neither of you stopped.
Sunday. You bought a shirt in a colour you already own.
Two days. You spent one of them getting ready for the other.
The weekend passed without incident and without remark.
Sunday evening arrived at 4:00 PM, as it does.

first: 9:00 AM. Monday. Your monitor faces the aisle.
monday: Monday, 9:00 AM. The building smells like carpet again.
Monday, 9:00 AM. There is a new memo in your tray. It is the old memo.
midweek: {weekdayLong}, 9:00 AM. Your monitor still faces the aisle.
{weekdayLong}, 9:00 AM. The fluorescent above your pod is now the subject of a ticket.
{weekdayLong}, 9:00 AM. Someone has moved the good chair. It is not your chair.

notices.save.unavailable: Corporate is not recording your progress. This browser declines to keep records.
notices.save.quota: Storage is full. Your day still happened. There is simply no record of it.
notices.save.tooNew: This record was written by a later version of the building. Nothing will be overwritten.
notices.save.corrupt: Your previous record was unreadable and has been set aside. Please begin again.
notices.save.leftEarly: You left before five. The day is being run again. It will go the same way.
notices.save.scratch: Pinned seed. This session is not being recorded.
